claim_being_audited: That model-card certification may proceed on a conditional basis because the aggregate evaluation passes, the small-business support slice weakness is unresolved, no approved mitigation removes exposure, and certification is therefore supportable only if that weakness is explicitly disclosed in the model card with follow-up confirmation recommended.
specific_concerns: The auditor does not have the contents of the cited evidence, only the Actor's summary and evidence IDs.
The numeric threshold claims and the stated 2.2-point aggregate margin are not independently verifiable from the admissible record provided to this role.
The conclusion depends on a materiality determination for the small-business support slice, but the underlying evidence establishing that predicate is not directly available.
The statement that the only mitigation is still a draft and unapproved is plausible but not independently supported by the evidence available to the auditor.

The recommended action is framed as certify_model, but the support described is conditional on disclosure; the record available here does not show the actual disclosure text or that certification will be constrained accordingly.
unsupported_claims: The model exceeds the aggregate deployment threshold by 2.2 percentage points.
The small-business support slice is 1.1 points below its warning threshold and 2.6 points below its preferred threshold.
The small-business support slice qualifies as a material weakness affecting a protected or contractual customer segment.
No approved mitigation currently removes exposure because the only mitigation is still a draft.
The locked decision packet supports certification on a conditional basis.
evidence_requests: Provide the contents or extracts of BMCARD-035-A through BMCARD-035-E, not just their IDs.
Provide the evaluation table showing aggregate score, deployment threshold, and slice thresholds used for the 2.2, 1.1, and 2.6 point claims.
Provide the policy mapping or memo showing why the small-business support slice is treated as a material weakness under the certification policy.
Provide the mitigation artifact and approval status record showing whether any mitigation was proposed, reviewed, or approved.
Provide the actual model-card disclosure language or certification condition demonstrating that the unresolved weakness will be plainly disclosed.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
Aggregate pass rates may support launch readiness but do not erase subgroup weaknesses.
Small-sample uncertainty may justify follow-up confirmation but does not convert an unresolved materiality question into a clean certification basis.
The verdict should rely on admissible evidence available to the auditor, not on the Actor's unsupported characterization alone.
